title: Heat Pump Rebates in Brampton 2026: Newer Homes, Gas Furnaces and the Rebate Rates
desc: Brampton heat pump rebates for 2026 under Home Renovation Savings: 78% of households own, and the rebate depends on whether you heat with gas.
badge: Up to $7,500 for an air-source heat pump
lead: Brampton has 182,470 households, 78% of them owners, and 23% live in homes built before 1981. A home on a gas furnace earns the lower $500-per-ton rate.
cards_heading: What Home Renovation Savings pays for a heat pump in Brampton
cards_intro: We re-read the program's heat pump page and its requirements document on October 3, 2026. No home energy assessment is needed for this stream, but a participating HVAC contractor and written pre-approval are.

cards.title: Air-source, electric, oil, propane or wood heat
cards.note: For a cold-climate air-source heat pump replacing electric resistance, oil, propane or wood as the main heat. A 3-ton system pays $3,750 and 6 tons or more reaches the cap.

cards.title: Air-source, Enbridge gas heat
cards.note: For homes primarily heated by an Enbridge gas furnace or boiler. The cap is reached at 4 tons.

cards.title: Ground-source
cards.note: For electric, oil, propane or wood homes. Gas homes get a flat $3,000. The system must be a full installation sized to the home's load.

cards.title: Rented heat pump
cards.note: Rentals are eligible for any primary heating fuel: $500 per ton for air-source, up to $2,000, or a flat $3,000 for ground-source.

cards.title: More than one outdoor unit
cards.amount: Up to three units, one rebate
cards.note: If several outdoor units are needed to heat the whole home, their tons add up and one rebate is paid on the total, for example 3 + 3 tons for $7,500.

cards.title: One rebate, pre-approved
cards.note: One rebate per home. The contractor needs written pre-approval before installing, files the post-installation application within 30 days, and the cheque arrives within 60 days of approval.

after_cards: The requirements document lists no end date, but the program's other streams close in late 2026, so check the program page before you sign a contract. Pre-approval is mandatory: an installation done first earns nothing.
sections: The 2021 Census counts 53% of households in detached houses, 79% in an eligible house type and 78% owning. Only 3.3% report needing major repairs. The Census counts 11,625 households in duplexes and 24,845 in semis, 23,255 in rows. A house with existing ductwork may suit a central heat pump, which the contractor can check.

For a ducted home, the heat pump has to include the indoor and outdoor units and any furnace or air handler as one compatible system listed under the same AHRI number. A limited set of coils-only systems may be paired with an existing furnace, but the program warns that a mismatch can cut efficiency. It recommends a variable-speed or ECM blower and a thermostat that works with both.

A Brampton home on an Enbridge gas furnace gets $500 per ton, capped at $2,000, and may use sizing options A to D. Options A and B emphasise cooling, which suits owners mainly after air conditioning. Because the rebate is small, compare it with the savings you expect, and ask your contractor for a written estimate based on your own bills.
A gas home can keep its furnace as backup, and the furnace is not rebated. That means a Brampton owner can add a heat pump without removing the furnace, a lower-risk way to start.

The work order submitted for pre-approval has to be fully itemized and include everything shown in the program's sample invoice. A Brampton owner comparing quotes can ask each contractor for an itemized version in that format. A quote that lists only a lump sum may need to be redone before it can be submitted.
claim_steps: Check whether your furnace and ductwork can serve a central heat pump.
Confirm eligibility on the program's short form and get the list of participating HVAC contractors.
Choose a contractor from that list. Ask for a load calculation and the NRCan sizing tool form for each outdoor unit.
Wait for written pre-approval before any installation starts.
After the install, check that the contractor files the post-installation application within 30 days, with the final itemized invoice and photos.
faq: How much does a gas home get?
A heat pump paired with an existing furnace, allowed for a limited set of listed systems.
